results.AlertName: Update High Availability Active Member DNS Record on AWS Route53 When Failover Occurs
results.Description: This example demonstrates updating the DNS record for non-Microsoft/BIND DNS when a High Availability pool member fails in a multi-subnet failover configuration. Amazon AWS Route53 is used in this example. To make this example fully operational, set up the AWS Tools for Windows PowerShell on your main SolarWinds Platform polling engine and main SolarWinds Platform polling engine backup http://docs.aws.amazon.com/powershell/latest/userguide/pstools-getting-set-up.html. Then edit the trigger action and provide your AWS credentials.
